description: 1952 is the Year of the Water Dragon in the Chinese zodiac, from January 27, 1952 to February 13, 1953. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1952 is the Year of the Water Dragon, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 27, 1952 and ended on February 13, 1953, so people born in 1952 before Jan 27 belong to the Metal Rabbit year.

sections.heading: When the 1952 Water Dragon year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1952 Water Dragon year began at Lunar New Year on January 27, 1952 and lasted until February 13, 1953, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 27 1952 therefore belongs to the Metal Rabbit year that started in 1951, while someone born in early 1953, up to Feb 13, is still a Water Dragon. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Water Dragon combination also falls in 2012, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1952 fell on a Sunday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Water Dragon personality
paragraphs: Diplomatic, far-sighted and calm under pressure, the Water Dragon is the strategist of its sign. The Dragon's Earth gives Water direction, which tradition reads as intuition channelled into purposeful action. People born in this year tend to be persuasive and good at reading a room. Hesitation is their usual weakness, so trusting sound analysis sooner is often recommended. People often seek their counsel in uncertain times.

Water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication. Descriptions associate it with wisdom, empathy and the ability to find a way around obstacles rather than through them. Water-year people are often portrayed as perceptive listeners, diplomatic and quietly persuasive, able to sense the mood of a room before anyone speaks. The element is linked with reflection and with the unseen, so it adds an inward, thoughtful layer. Its shadow, in most readings, is drift: indecision, secrecy, and a tendency to take on the shape of whoever is nearby.

sections.heading: 1952 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the digits reduce to 8, associated with ambition, authority and material results, so an 8 year is described in terms of effort and reward. The digits of 1952 add up to 17, which reduces to 8. In the twelve-year cycle the Dragon is the fifth animal, earthly branch Chen, with Earth as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Water, and in the five-element cycles earth controls Water. The year before was the Metal Rabbit and the year after is the Water Snake.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Ren-Chen: Ren is the Water heavenly stem and Chen is the Dragon's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1952?
faq.answer: 1952 is the Year of the Water Dragon. It started on January 27, 1952 and ended on February 13, 1953.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1952?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 27. Born before January 27, 1952, you are a Metal Rabbit; born on or after it, you are a Water Dragon.

faq.question: What element is 1952 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yang year. The Dragon's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1952?
faq.answer: Ren-Chen. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Dragon year?
faq.answer: 2012, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2012.
